courses.summaryEn: Optical I/O chiplets links device physics and system validation through lanes, optical wavelengths, energy and end-to-end usable capacity. This representative location illustrates the research and packaging ecosystem; the curriculum draws on several public sources.
courses.connection: 以通道、光波長、能量及端到端可用容量比較相關工法；重新核對材料、波段、控制拓撲與驗收門檻。
courses.connectionEn: Compare related methods through lanes, optical wavelengths, energy and end-to-end usable capacity, rechecking materials, wavelength, control topology and acceptance limits.
